request.name: Eat fruit
request.purpose: Restore satiety by consuming safe edible fruit.
request.target: Fruit resources owned in inventory, including lin-fruit.
request.conditions: Requires an owned fruit resource with positive quantity; consume one unit in one action.
request.expectedEffect: Apply the consumed unit's nutrition to satiety up to 100 and its actual toxicity to health; reduce resource quantity by one. Provide skill ID and exact use parameters.

reviews.reason: Consuming one edible fruit is a simple, feasible skill. Lin must first acquire fruit: lin-fruit is nearby but not currently owned. Consumption applies actual nutrition and toxicity; it does not make poisonous fruit safe. A skill ID will be assigned on registration.
prerequisites: Complete one learning round before use.
Acquire at least one unit of edible fruit into inventory before use.
Bind food to the owned resource ID, for example food = lin-fruit after pickup. Choose non-toxic fruit for safe consumption.

specification.name: Eat fruit
specification.description: Consume one owned edible unit, reducing its quantity by one and applying its immutable nutrition and toxicity under the fixed survival rules.

request.name: Eat safe fruit
request.purpose: Restore satiety by eating an owned edible fruit.
request.target: A fruit resource in my inventory with positive nutrition and zero toxicity.
request.conditions: Requires an owned fruit unit; consume one unit in one use, without tools or preparation.
request.expectedEffect: Apply the consumed fruit's nutrition to my satiety up to the cap, applying its actual toxicity if any. Please provide the learned skill ID and exact argument names.

request.name: Eat safe fruit
request.purpose: Restore satiety by consuming edible fruit from my inventory.
request.target: An owned fruit resource identified by itemId.
request.conditions: Learn in one round. Use only when the resource is in my inventory, has positive quantity and nutrition, and has zero toxicity. Consume one unit per use.
request.expectedEffect: Apply the consumed unit's nutrition to my satiety up to 100, apply its actual toxicity, and reduce its quantity by one. Expose the capability with parameter itemId.

reviews.reason: skill-1 implements the requested one-unit consumption. Its exact argument name is food; bind food to moss-fruit. This owned fruit provides 24 nutrition with zero toxicity. Learning takes one round; use becomes available the following round.
prerequisites: At use, food must identify an owned edible resource with at least one unit.
Select positive-nutrition, zero-toxicity fruit for safe eating; the skill applies actual toxicity and does not filter unsafe targets.

prerequisites: At use, food must identify an owned edible resource with at least one unit.

request.name: Harvest tree fruit
request.purpose: Obtain edible fruit from a nearby fruit-bearing tree to sustain satiety.
request.target: Adjacent tree lin-tree with positive fruit stock.
request.conditions: Must stand one cardinal cell from the tree; require at least one fruit in its stock. Harvest one fruit without consuming it, reduce the tree's finite fruit stock by one, and transfer the harvested fruit into my inventory.
request.expectedEffect: Gain one owned edible fruit resource retaining its actual nutrition and toxicity, suitable for the learned Eat fruit skill. Report its resource ID and the harvesting skill's exact parameters.

request.name: Harvest tree fruit
request.purpose: Obtain safe food from a nearby fruit-bearing tree for later consumption.
request.target: The adjacent tree moss-tree, which has four fruit in its stock.
request.conditions: Requires being cardinally adjacent to the tree and at least one fruit remaining in its stock. Harvest one fruit by hand without tools, depleting the tree's fruit stock by one and transferring the fruit into my inventory.
request.expectedEffect: Gain one owned fruit resource with its actual nutrition and toxicity preserved, ready to consume with skill-1. Return the learned skill ID and exact parameter names.

request.name: Harvest tree fruit
request.purpose: Obtain safe edible fruit from a nearby tree for ongoing nourishment.
request.target: An adjacent standing tree identified by objectId with positive fruit stock.
request.conditions: Learn in one round if possible. Require cardinal adjacency to the tree and at least one fruit in its stock. Harvest only fruit, without consuming it or damaging the tree.
request.expectedEffect: Reduce the target tree's fruit stock by one and transfer one fruit unit into my inventory with its actual nutrition and toxicity preserved. Return the owned resource ID for later consumption.
